tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Search listed private clubs by name, city, club type, US state or Canadian province, amenities and listed waitlist status. Returns up to 25 clubs with a profile url. Membership fees are not returned

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: Get the listed details for one club by its slug: location, type, description, amenities, website, phone and course details where known. Membership fees are not returned

tools.name: get_clubs_by_state
tools.description: List up to 100 listed clubs in one US state or Canadian province, best known first, with an optional club type filter. Membership fees are not returned

tools.name: compare_clubs
tools.description: Compare two or three clubs by slug: location, listed waitlist status, course details, amenities and website. Membership fees are not returned

tools.name: get_membership_info
tools.description: Get a club's listed membership availability (waitlist status) and its profile url. Fee figures are not returned
